WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS mean_event_avg_remaining
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_spent,
    avg_remaining,
    avg_remaining - mean_event_avg_remaining AS difference
FROM with_mean
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
